description: Utility functions and types for handling component schemas, document features, and property paths in a document editor context within a larger project.

methods.name: findChildPropPathsForProp
methods.description: Recursively finds property paths with options within a component schema based on the provided value and schema.

methods.name: findChildPropPaths
methods.description: Finds child property paths for a given object of props and their schemas.

methods.name: assertNever
methods.description: Utility to ensure exhaustive type checking; throws error if called.

methods.name: getDocumentFeaturesForChildField
methods.description: Determines document features configuration for a child field based on editor features and options.

methods.name: getSchemaAtPropPath
methods.description: Retrieves the schema at a specific property path within a component schema.

methods.name: clientSideValidateProp
methods.description: Validates a value against a component schema on the client side.

methods.name: getAncestorSchemas
methods.description: Returns the list of ancestor schemas leading to a specific property path.

methods.name: getValueAtPropPath
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific property path within a nested object.

methods.name: traverseProps
methods.description: Traverses all properties in a schema and value, applying a visitor function.

methods.name: replaceValueAtPropPath
methods.description: Replaces the value at a specific property path within a nested object according to schema.

methods.name: getPlaceholderTextForPropPath
methods.description: Gets placeholder text for a property path based on schema options.
